title: ARSIA Audit Record
description: Immutable, append-only audit record produced for every compliance-relevant event processed by an ARSIA agent. Defined in ARSIA-State.md §7.1. Audit records link a protocol event to the originating message, the participating agents, the compliance profile, and the human oversight status, enabling regulators and auditors to reconstruct the full lifecycle of any regulated interaction. The record stores a SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized payload (not the raw payload), so audit records do not contain personal data and are exempt from GDPR Art. 17 erasure.

allOf.description: Unique identifier for this audit record (UUID v4). Generated by the agent that creates the record. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.
The id field of the ARSIA message that this record documents (UUID v4). Links the audit record to the originating message. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

event_type.description: The type of event being audited. Values correspond to protocol operations: request/response/event/error/pending_approval/approval_decision are envelope intents; approval_expired is an oversight deadline expiry (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.4); state_set/state_delete/state_grant/state_revoke/state_purge are State operations (ARSIA-State.md §3); asset_transfer is an Assets operation (ARSIA-Assets.md §3); broker_relay is a Compliance Broker relay (ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4); key_rotation is an Identity key lifecycle event (ARSIA-Identity.md §2.4, §2.5); rollback is an action rollback (ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2); ict_incident is a DORA incident record (ARSIA-Assets.md §6.2.3). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

from_agent.description: The agent-id of the message sender. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

to_agent.description: The agent-id of the message recipient. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

intent.description: The intent field from the originating message (ARSIA-Core.md §4.1). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

payload_type.description: The payload.type field from the originating message. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the payload from the originating message. When security.encrypted is false or absent: SHA-256(RFC8785(payload)). When security.encrypted is true: SHA-256(UTF-8(JWE string)). Verifiable without decryption keys. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1 and ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the RFC 8785 canonicalized plaintext payload. Present ONLY when the originating message has security.encrypted=true. Enables dispute resolution over encrypted content. MUST NOT be present when security.encrypted is false or absent. See ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

human_oversight_status.description: Status of human oversight for this event. 'not_required': oversight was not triggered; 'pending': event is awaiting human approval; 'approved': a human approved the action; 'denied': a human denied the action; 'expired': the approval deadline passed without a decision. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

approver_id.description: The agent-id of the agent that issued the approval_decision, when human_oversight_status is 'approved' or 'denied'. Provides accountability for oversight decisions. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC designator, indicating when this event was processed and the audit record created. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC designator. The date until which this audit record MUST be retained, computed as retention_anchor + effective_retention using calendar arithmetic (ARSIA-Core.md §4.3.6.4.1). After this date, the record MAY be archived or deleted subject to §7.3 archival rules. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or supranational identifier (e.g. 'EU') for the geographic zone where this audit record is stored. When present, MUST match the originating message's compliance.data_residency value. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

operator_id.description: The owner_id from the IdentityRecord (ARSIA-Identity.md §1.2) of the agent that owns this audit log. Establishes legal accountability for the audit record. The identity layer is jurisdiction-agnostic, so this MAY be a VAT number, LEI URN, DUNS URN, or any national company registration number. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: The record's chain value: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical form of {"previous_chain_value": P, "record": R'}, where R' is the complete record without hash_chain and P is the chain value of the preceding entry (null at position 1). REQUIRED at the Compliance and Full conformance levels and OPTIONAL (RECOMMENDED) at Core (ARSIA-State.md §7.2) — a level-dependent rule enforced at runtime, not expressible in this schema. Present together with the other chain fields or not at all. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1, §7.2.

Identifier of the chain the record belongs to; all entries of a chain carry the same chain_id. REQUIRED at the Compliance and Full conformance levels and OPTIONAL (RECOMMENDED) at Core (ARSIA-State.md §7.2) — a level-dependent rule enforced at runtime, not expressible in this schema. Present together with the other chain fields or not at all. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1, §7.2.

chain_seq.description: Position of the record in its chain: 1 for the first entry, the previous entry's position plus 1 thereafter. REQUIRED at the Compliance and Full conformance levels and OPTIONAL (RECOMMENDED) at Core (ARSIA-State.md §7.2) — a level-dependent rule enforced at runtime, not expressible in this schema. Present together with the other chain fields or not at all. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1, §7.2.

chain_format.description: Chain-format version: the construction of ARSIA-State.md §7.2 used to compute hash_chain; this specification defines format 1. REQUIRED at the Compliance and Full conformance levels and OPTIONAL (RECOMMENDED) at Core (ARSIA-State.md §7.2) — a level-dependent rule enforced at runtime, not expressible in this schema. Present together with the other chain fields or not at all. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

sub_type.description: Escrow sub-type. Present when event_type is 'asset_transfer' and the event relates to an escrow lifecycle transition. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.

payment_reference.description: Payment reference from the originating AssetTransferRequest. Present in escrow audit records for traceability. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.

amount.description: The escrowed or transferred amount. Present in escrow_created audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

currency_or_unit.description: Currency code or unit identifier from the transfer. Present in escrow_created audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

release_agent.description: Agent-id of the authorised escrow release agent. Present in escrow_created audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

allOf.description: Escrow deadline timestamp. Present in escrow_created and escrow_returned audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1, §4.3.3.

released_by.description: Agent-id of the agent that triggered the escrow release. Present in escrow_released audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2.

release_trigger.description: The payload.type of the release message that triggered escrow release. Present in escrow_released audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2.

allOf.description: UUID v4 referencing the audit_id from the escrow creation record. Links subsequent escrow events to the originating escrow. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2–§4.3.4.
Actual time the escrow timeout was processed. Present in escrow_returned audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.3.

cancellation_reason.description: Reason for a sender-initiated escrow cancellation. Present in escrow_returned audit records generated by a cancellation, in place of actual_timeout. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.2.4 and §4.3.3.

disputed_by.description: Agent-id of the party that raised the escrow dispute. Present in escrow_disputed audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

dispute_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the escrow dispute. Present in escrow_disputed audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

arbitration_agent.description: Agent-id of the arbitration agent assigned to resolve the escrow dispute. Present in escrow_disputed audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

risk_level.description: Risk level from the ActionDescriptor for the requested action. Present in oversight audit records for the original request. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 1.

allOf.description: UUID v4 linking oversight audit records to the originating request or pending_approval message. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Records 2–4.
UUID v4 of the original request of an oversight cycle. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Records 2–4 and the expiry record.
Approval deadline timestamp from the pending_approval message. Present when event_type is 'pending_approval'. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 2.

reason.description: Reason field. In approval_decision and approval_expired records, the reason from the decision if provided, else null (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 3). In state_purge records, OPTIONAL (ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2). In key_rotation records for a revocation, 'revocation' (ARSIA-Identity.md §2.5).

decision.description: Oversight decision: 'approved' or 'denied' in approval_decision records (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 3); 'expired' in approval_expired records (§3.5, Path 3 expiry).

outcome.description: Final outcome of an oversight cycle, carried by its final response or error record. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 4.

allOf.description: The id of the original response message that confirmed the execution being rolled back — the value of the rollback request's payload.args.original_message_id. Required in rollback records. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2 (Rollback Request, Rollback Audit).
The action_id of the rolled-back action (ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1). Required in rollback records. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2 (Rollback Audit).

partial_rollback.description: Whether the rollback was partial (true) or full (false). Required in rollback records. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2 (Rollback Semantics rule 3, Rollback Audit).

key.description: State entry key. Present in state_set, state_delete, and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.2.2.

owner_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the state entry owner. Present in state_set, state_delete, and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.2.2.

actor_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent that performed the operation. May differ from owner_agent_id when operating via a grant. Present in state_set and state_delete audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3.

initiator_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent that initiated the purge operation. Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

generation.description: Generation of the state entry (ARSIA-State.md §2.1.14). Present in state_set, state_delete and state_purge records; in a state_purge record, the latest generation the PURGE covers.

version.description: State entry version after the operation. Present in state_set and state_delete audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3.

pii_classification.description: GDPR classification of the state entry data. Present in state_set and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.2.2.

pii_special_categories.description: GDPR Art. 9(1) special category types. OPTIONAL in state_set audit records: when present, the entry's pii_special_categories (pii_classification 'sensitive'). Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.11 and §7.1.

legal_basis.description: GDPR legal basis from the message's compliance.legal_basis field. Art. 6(1) grounds for 'personal' entries, Art. 9(2) grounds for 'sensitive' entries. Present in state_set audit records when pii_classification is 'personal' or 'sensitive'. Per ARSIA-State.md §8.3 Rule 3.

allOf.description: Event time — when the operation occurred at the origin. Distinct from processed_at (ingestion time). Present in state_set, state_delete, state_grant, and state_revoke audit records (ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.3.1, §3.3.2) and, as the ts of the documented message, in oversight audit records (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5).

Timestamp of actual data destruction. Distinct from processed_at (ingestion time) and timestamp (event time). Has autonomous legal significance for GDPR Art. 5(2) accountability. Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

within_retention.description: Whether the PURGE removed values still within retention, as determined by the implementation from stored state (never from the request). Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

entry_retained_until.description: The latest instant created_at + effective retention of the generations whose values the PURGE removed, or null when none has a retention period. Not the retention of this record (retained_until). Present in state_purge audit records; a timestamp, never null, when within_retention is true. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

retention_override.description: The retention_override of the PURGE request, when it carried one; REQUIRED when within_retention is true. It does not affect the retention of this record. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

allOf.description: UUID identifier of the access grant. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

key_pattern.description: Key or key prefix pattern for the grant. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

grantor_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent granting access. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

grantee_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent receiving access. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

access_level.description: Access level of the grant. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

valid_until.description: Grant expiry timestamp or null for no expiry. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

compliance_profile_declared.description: Profile name as declared in the message (null = compliance present without profile; 'none' = no compliance field). State §7.1.

compliance_profile_resolved.description: Profile actually applied after the Core §4.3.7 precedence chain. State §7.1.

declared_retention.description: Declared retention duration from the message, or null.

retention_anchor.description: Instant retention is measured from — the record's own creation instant (Core §4.3.6.4.1).

counterparty_owner_id.description: owner_id of the other party to the audited message (Identity §4.1, State §7.1). Required at runtime when audit_required and resolvable; schema-optional.

deployer_id.description: The deployer_id from the IdentityRecord of the agent that owns this audit log, recorded when that IdentityRecord sets deployer_id different from owner_id (split responsibility model). Per ARSIA-Identity.md §4.4.

allOf.description: Timestamp of the JWKS fetch whose keys were used to verify the audited message's signature (Core §5.2, Verification Caching / stale-key behaviour). Required at runtime for compliance-relevant signed messages; schema-optional.
Relay attestation identifier (Routing §7.4)
The relaying broker's own agent-id. Required in broker_relay records. Per ARSIA-Core.md §9.2 item 4 and ARSIA-Routing.md §7.3 Rule 7, §7.4.2.
The relayed message's ts (Core §9.2 item 4)
When the broker received the envelope
When the broker initiated forwarding

rejection_cause.description: Identifies the audit record of a rejection produced by compliance validation (ARSIA-Core.md §4.3.8, §4.3.10.6), for a message of any intent. Requires event_type 'error', obligation_resolution with outcome 'rejected' and a non-empty conflicts, and correlation_id set to the id of the rejected message. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: The id of the terminal result reviewed — Actions §3.9.2, §3.9.5
SHA-256 of the terminal result's payload, computed as payload_hash — Actions §3.9.3
Review deadline (review_pending: earliest obligation deadline; review_overdue: the overdue obligation's deadline) — Actions §3.9.2

review_mode.description: The post-execution mode of the obligation concerned — Actions §3.9.5

escalation_result.description: Result of escalating an overdue obligation — Actions §3.9.4

escalation_attempts.description: Delivery attempts made for the overdue notice (at most 3 retries) — Actions §3.9.4

late.description: true exactly when the decision completed the review as completed_late — Actions §3.9.4

allOf.$comment: broker_relay extension fields per Routing §7.4.2 (M-05 unification)

declared.description: {present: false} when the sub-field was omitted; {present: true, value} when declared, including a value that was then rejected.

fill.description: Filled value and its fill source; a filled null is {value: null, source}; null when the sub-field was not filled.

fact.description: Index in facts of the fact this requirement derives from, or null.

allowed.description: Residency restriction: the normalized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes allowed.

requirements.description: Requirements applied; an empty array means the axis carries no obligation.

result.description: Composed oversight set; an empty array means no oversight mode applies.

requirements.description: Requirements applied; an empty array means the axis carries no obligation.
Requirements applied; an empty array means the axis carries no obligation.

result.description: Composed retention with its anchor and retained_until.

requirements.description: Requirements applied; an empty array means the axis carries no obligation.

result.description: Non-empty allowed set of normalized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes; no effective restriction is status no-value.

obligation-resolution.description: Effective obligation resolution (ARSIA-Core.md §4.3.10), held inline. Records which obligations applied; not evidence that they were fulfilled. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.
